title: ThemeToggleBar: remove cat icon, theme-driven circle indicator, add Green color scheme

requirements.summary: Remove the cat image from ThemeToggleBar while keeping a circular indicator next to the color scheme toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: A circular UI element remains next to the color scheme toggle button in ThemeToggleBar.
No broken image icon or empty element is present in the ThemeToggleBar.

file_operations.description: Remove the usage of the cat asset and replace it with a non-image circular indicator element rendered next to the color scheme toggle (no empty/broken image). Keep using the existing shadcn-ui Button composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make the ThemeToggleBar circular indicator automatically reflect the active color scheme using theme CSS variables.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user switches the color scheme, the circle’s fill color changes accordingly without requiring a page reload.
The circle color is derived from the active theme/color-scheme CSS variables (e.g., primary/accent), not hard-coded to black.
The circle remains clearly visible in both light and dark theme modes.

file_operations.description: Style the circular indicator using Tailwind color tokens backed by CSS variables (e.g., primary/accent/ring) so it automatically updates when data-color-scheme changes and remains visible in light/dark. Keep composition with shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a Green option to the color scheme switcher with state/persistence updates and CSS variable overrides for light and dark modes.
acceptanceCriteria: The color scheme state supports three values: blue, purple, and green, and continues to persist via localStorage.
The UI control in ThemeToggleBar cycles through Blue, Purple, and Green and displays the correct label for the current scheme.
The document root attribute data-color-scheme updates to "green" when green is selected.

frontend/src/index.css includes a green color-scheme override for light mode (:root[data-color-scheme="green"]) and dark mode (.dark[data-color-scheme="green"]) covering primary/accent/ring (and any other scheme-specific variables currently overridden for blue).

file_operations.description: Extend color-scheme state management to support 'green' in addition to existing values, including localStorage validation/persistence and applying data-color-scheme='green' to the document root when selected.

Update the color scheme toggle logic to cycle through Blue, Purple, and Green; update displayed label(s) and aria-label(s) to reflect all three schemes. Continue composing the existing shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add CSS variable overrides for the green color scheme for both light (:root[data-color-scheme="green"]) and dark (.dark[data-color-scheme="green"]) modes, covering the same set of scheme-specific variables currently overridden for blue (including primary/accent/ring and related chart/sidebar variables).
